sources.title: NYPL Young Lions Fiction Award — submission criteria

freeEntry.quote: No fee is mentioned, but entry is not open to the public: publishers submit, not authors.

prize.quote: The prize amount is not stated on the submission-criteria page that was read.

deadline.text: Submission materials due 2026-09-03 5 PM EDT — already past on the audit date
deadline.quote: All submission materials ... must be received ... September 3, 2026 at 5 PM EDT.

eligibility.text: US citizen, 35 or younger at publication; adult novel, graphic novel or short-story collection published in 2026; publisher submission only
eligibility.quote: Publisher submission only; authors cannot submit directly.

aiPolicy.quote: Not addressed in the criteria read.

summary: Not an open competition: publishers nominate, the deadline passed on 2026-09-03, and the page's 'now open' label conflicts with its own date. The ledger's '$10,000 grand prize' is not on the page that was read.
flags: Page says submissions are 'now open' but gives a deadline of 2026-09-03, before the audit date.
Publisher-only nomination — an individual cannot enter.
Ledger's $10,000 prize could not be found on the source read.
